Over the past five years, we have completed or reviewed more than 400 on-site audits of our 
suppliers. We also conduct “conflict minerals” audits, which are not included in this table. For  
more information, see “Conflict-Free Products” later in this section.

1   Total includes on-site third-party audits completed, as well as reviews of third-party audits completed using  
the EICC VAP. 
2  Including Intel-led targeted audits on specific topics and quality assessments that include CSR criteria.
